title: OpenVPN client configurations
whyItMatters: OpenVPN profiles can inline certificates and keys and name remote networks. They show which private networks this PC could reach.
source: OpenVPN GUI docs: per-user config directory C:/Users/<user>/OpenVPN/config - https://github.com/OpenVPN/openvpn-gui/blob/master/README.rst
notes: Per-user profiles only; the system-wide C:/Program Files/OpenVPN/config tree is not covered. .ovpn files, certificates and keys are never opened.
